explanation: Store complete words in a set. Search scans words of exactly the pattern length and compares each position, accepting a literal match or a dot wildcard. Matching requires the full pattern and word lengths to agree.
timeComplexity: O(L) expected insertion hashing work; O(U(P+1)) worst-case scan for U words and pattern length P.
spaceComplexity: O(S+U) stored strings/set entries; O(U+P) transient references/characters per search.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
